text:
Jamie (Product): Quick breakout: ACME asked for a private pilot w/ tight launch criteria: 99.95% SLA, p95 <200ms for short prompts, BYOK KMS/HSM option, and 30d audit retention. Can we map cross-team deps and rough ETAs? :eyes:

Priya (Customer Success): They need a compliance demo in ~8 weeks. High priority from their side; they'll sign if we show path to SLA and controls.

Rajat (Eng-runtime): Latency target doable with dedicated pool + model pinning and tenant prewarm/KV seeding. Estimate ~3w of runtime work to add tenant prewarm + safe rollout hooks. Need perf harness to validate p95.

Maya (Infra): We need to pick instance SKUs (A10G vs A100), NIC tuning, VPC peering test, and quota reservation. HSM network ACLs require infra tickets. ~2w to provision/devtest once prioritized.

Luis (Security): BYOK KMS for pilot reduces scope. Full HSM integration is larger (2-3 sprints) for enterprise compliance. Schedule a 1hr risk review and capture audit events for SLA appendix.

Talia (Eng): Need model-version pinning + canary rollout with automatic fallback to hosted variant. Also token-level latency metrics. Suggest canary policy 5%->25%->100% over 48h with auto rollback if p95 increases >25% or errors >0.5%.

Sam (SRE): I'll draft SLIs/alerts and the runbook. Define error budget and rollback path (auto switch to hosted model + notify). Who owns cost risk if pilot spikes? Recommend cost caps and alerts.

Jamie (Product): Proposed MVP scope: 1) Dedicated tenant pool + prewarm; 2) BYOK KMS for pilot; 3) Model pin + canary rollouts; 4) SLA doc + runbook + daily latency reports. Target: 6 weeks to pilot if infra/runtime prioritized.

Rajat (Eng-runtime): 6w optimistic but feasible with prioritized resources. Req: 2 runtime engineers (3 preferred), 1 infra eng, security review slot. I'll spin up a perf harness and prototype prewarm. Example prewarm config:

```
prewarm:
  enabled: true
  concurrency: 4
  kv_seed_size: 32
  warm_duration: 900
  fallback_on_error: true
```

Maya (Infra): Can assign 1 infra eng; will push other tickets. If Product marks "pilot-priority" I'll escalate for more capacity. Need perf windows to validate p95 on chosen SKUs.

Luis (Security): I'll produce a BYOK checklist and book the risk review. For audit retention we'll need storage plan and retention policy in SLA.

Talia (Eng): I'll add the canary policy to the epic once created. Need owners for monitoring thresholds.

Priya (Customer Success): ACME wants daily latency reports and a single POC. They'll accept cost caps with alerts at 50%/80% usage.

Jamie (Product): Owners: Rajat (runtime & canary), Maya (infra), Luis (security), Sam (runbook/alerts), Priya (customer comms). Action items: create JIRA epic (today), Rajat: prototype prewarm & harness (ETA 10 working days), Maya: reserve SKUs & test VPC (ETA 7 working days), Luis: schedule risk review & BYOK checklist (ETA 5 working days), Sam: runbook draft (ETA 4 working days), Priya: confirm budget cap & POC (ETA 2 working days).

Jamie (Product): Sync tomorrow 11:00am PT. If ETAs slip we'll revise scope (likely drop HSM and extend SLA ramp). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder — add the epic key to #product when created.

Rajat (Eng-runtime): I'll post perf numbers to thread when harness is up.

Maya (Infra): Noted; will escalate allocation if needed to hit 6w timeline.

Sam (SRE): I'll include rollback runbook and alert thresholds in draft.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll confirm ACME POC and budget cap today and update thread.

Talia (Eng): Adding canary policy to the epic after Jamie creates it.

Jamie (Product): Thanks all — invite out in 5.
